name: Latvian Open 2016

venue.name: [Riga Plaza shopping center](http://www.rigaplaza.lv/en/)
venue.details: Ask the info center where to find the competition place.

information: Latvian Open is one of the biggest speedcubing competitions in the Baltic countries. The competition will be held on 22-23 October in Riga.15 disciplines where you can take part yourself or see the best Latvian speedcubers. The participation fee will be 10eur.
